problem: Overcoming weaknesses of conventional machine translation systems
method: Developing a neural machine translation system with improved efficiency and rare word handling
key_result: GNMT achieves competitive results on benchmark tests and reduces translation errors by 60% compared to Google's phrase-based system
one_liner: Researchers develop a neural machine translation system, GNMT, that improves efficiency, handles rare words, and reduces translation errors by 60% compared to Google's existing system.
